title: Algorithmic Insurance
abstract: arXiv:2106.00839v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When artificial intelligence (AI) systems make errors in high-stakes domains such as medical diagnosis or autonomous driving, a single algorithmic flaw across varying contexts can generate heterogeneous losses that challenge traditional insurance assumptions. Algorithmic insurance, financial coverage for AI-induced damages, is an emerging market, yet insurers struggle to price these risks and AI developers lack frameworks linking system design to liability exposure. We connect a key operational choice in binary classification, how practitioners set decision thresholds, to tail risk exposure. Using conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) to capture extreme losses, we prove that established approaches such as accuracy maximization can significantly increase worst-case losses relative to tail risk optimization, with penalties growing at least quadratically as thresholds deviate from optimal. translated_abstract: 当人工智能（AI）系统在医学诊断或自动驾驶等高风险领域出现错误时，一个在不同情境中相同的单一算法缺陷可能产生异质性的损失，这挑战了传统保险的假设。算法保险，即为AI造成的损害提供财务保障的新兴市场正在兴起，然而保险公司在为这类风险定价时面临困难，AI开发者也缺乏将系统设计与责任风险敞口相关联的框架。我们将二元分类中的一个关键操作选择——从业者如何设置决策阈值——与尾部风险敞口联系起来。利用条件风险价值（CVaR）来刻画极端损失，我们证明了准确率最大化等既有方法相对于尾部风险优化会显著增加最坏情况下的损失，且当阈值偏离最优值时，惩罚至少以二次方速度增长。我们提出了一种责任保险合同，要求……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文开创了“算法保险”这一新兴领域，通过条件风险价值（CVaR）将二元分类中的决策阈值选择与尾部风险敞口联系起来，证明了准确率最大化等传统方法会显著放大最坏情况损失，并据此提出了将AI系统设计决策与责任风险敞口相挂钩的保险合同框架。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers algorithmic insurance by linking decision threshold choices in binary classification to tail risk exposure through CVaR, proving that conventional approaches like accuracy maximization significantly increase worst-case losses, and proposing an insurance contract framework that connects AI system design to liability exposure.
